text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho magnificently claimed glory at 
the Shuka Sho. What's more, she could 
sense that her performance today had 
changed the way the crowd looked at her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, to truly perfect the racing 
magic, two more things were needed: a 
"special rival," and "proof that Sweep 
Tosho is truly special."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just being the representative for this 
year's Triple Tiara route wasn't enough. 
She had to become something even more 
special.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, they decided to enter the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup next, taking on 
competitors from the Senior class who had 
walked the Triple Tiara path.
